description: Shared references: rename Parent (referenced by the Child foreign key and QJoin), then rename T (referenced by QSel, QParam and QAct) through TableDef.Name. Asks what the engine rewrites in relationships, saved query text and the other catalog rows, and what it leaves. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it. The full catalog view is taken before the steps and after them (each a read-only open, with its own file state).
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
